Group sets and membership builder

/teach/courses/:courseId/groups
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S15, S21

Create assessment group sets with complete enrollment coverage and versioned membership changes that preserve existing group work.

Dialogs and drawers (2)
Change membership after work
  • Old/new group, effective time, affected open assessments
  • Existing submission membership remains frozen; no automatic transfer of other group's private artifacts
Return without applying changesApply prospective membership
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide layout compares unassigned learners and group rosters; narrow web uses a group selector and one member list.
  • Keep enrollment snapshot/version and unresolved count above lists; Move to group works without dragging.
Accessibility
  • Group lists have headings, member counts and named Move to group controls; announce destination after a move.
  • Membership-impact dialog reads old/new group and effective date; restore focus to moved member. Never encode assignment status by colour alone.
Data
  • Group-set version, enrollment snapshot, current membership and assessment receipt membership are separate fictional records.
  • TA receives only authorised group/receipt scope; no full-roster payload. Joins/withdrawals append history and never rewrite submitted recipients.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • A group assignment cannot publish with unresolved targeted members.
  • One received group attempt has one receipt for all snapshot members; resubmission creates a new immutable receipt.
  • Individual grade overrides attach to a member with reason and never mutate the shared submitted artifact.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
